project_name: Machine Learning Internship Capstone - Customer Churn Prediction

internship_evaluator.verdict: Satisfies all 25 core internship requirements across dataset audit, leakage-safe preprocessing, baseline benchmarking, hyperparameter tuning, locked holdout evaluation, explainability, risk ranking, web dashboard, and QA.

ml_engineer.verdict: Rigorous binary classification formulation. Zero target leakage (customerID & Churn isolated prior to fitting). Stratified 80/20 split (5,634 train / 1,409 test, seed 42). Probability calibration (Brier 0.1362) and post-hoc threshold trade-offs thoroughly evaluated.

senior_developer.verdict: Clean full-stack web architecture (React 19 + Vite + Express + Tailwind v4). Modular components, clean server data layer, zero unhandled exceptions, and 64 passing unit tests.

technical_interviewer.verdict: Comprehensive 24-question technical Q&A guide (docs/INTERVIEW_TALKING_POINTS.md) prepared with honest, evidence-based responses and clear limitation acknowledgments.

github_reviewer.verdict: Repository is clean, well-structured, secret-free (0 keys found), contains .gitignore protecting binary/temp artifacts, and features an informative README.md.

recruiter.verdict: Clear value proposition, professional dark-first web dashboard preview, ATS-optimized resume bullet points (docs/RESUME_BULLETS.md), and LinkedIn post templates.
